transcript.content:
hey, i'm berry

tell me your dream, however it comes back to you. bits and pieces are fine
hi berry 🙂 ok so it was at the Meads's house but it was bigger inside than out. like right inside the door there was a whole european village with a cobblestone street. that part really stuck with me

a whole village just inside the front door. i love that

what was it like when you first stepped onto that cobblestone street?
honestly i don't remember much about stepping onto it, like how it felt. i just remember there was this guy there, kind of a pied piper sort of man with curly hair. he could do stuff like juggle

that's fine, dreams let go of stuff like that

a pied piper sort of guy, juggling on a cobblestone street inside someone's house. ha

what else could he do?
i don't remember exactly, just that he could do things like juggle. that's the only one that stuck. then i went up the back stairs, which is weird bc the real house doesn't have any

back stairs the real house doesn't even have. dreams love doing that

where did they take you?
honestly nowhere really, i went up and then straight back down the other side bc there was a second set of stairs right there. then down this short empty hallway that turned a corner

up and straight back down again, then an empty hallway. kind of a funny little loop

besides the juggling guy, was anyone else around, like in the village or in the house?

around the corner there was this tiny room and a young woman was in there cooking. the stove almost filled the whole room lol. she was nice to me

don't remember anyone else in the village though, just the juggling guy

a stove that almost fills the whole room, ha. and she was nice to you

what was she cooking?
no idea, i don't remember what she was making. i just remember her, she had shoulder length blonde hair in like a pageboy cut

that's okay, the food can stay a mystery. a blonde pageboy cut is a pretty specific thing to remember though

what happened after you found her?
then i was outside waiting for my aunt to pick me up. she showed up in this little round convertible and we went for a drive

a little round convertible, ha. i can almost picture your aunt pulling up in that

when you were riding along with her, were you just you, like your usual self? or did it feel more like you were watching it all from outside?
i don't really remember that, it just felt normal i guess. we didn't go far, just crossed a little bridge over a creek and then turned back, and she dropped me off at the house again

felt normal is fair, that's usually how it is in dreams

a quick little loop over the creek and right back to the house. kind of like the stairs

what did that little round convertible look like?

ha yeah it was like the stairs. i don't remember much about the car, just that it was little and round and a convertible. no idea what color or anything

after that i was sitting with a couple people playing with a string of blue balloons. i think that was inside

a string of blue balloons, that's a sweet little thing to end up with

i keep thinking about that tiny room where the stove almost filled the whole thing. what else was in there with her?
i don't remember anything else in there honestly. just her and the stove, and the stove took up most of the room so i don't think there was space for much else lol

ha fair, not much room left with a stove that big

so you were sitting with a couple people and those blue balloons. what happened after that?
nothing i can remember, that's where it ends for me. just sitting there with the balloons

okay, here's what i've got

you were at the Meads's house, but it was bigger inside than out. right inside the door there was a whole european village with a cobblestone street, and a pied piper sort of guy with curly hair who could do things like juggle. you went up some back stairs the real house doesn't have, then straight back down a second set on the other side, down a short empty hallway that turned a corner. around it was a tiny room where a young woman with shoulder length blonde hair in a pageboy cut was cooking, and the stove almost filled the whole room. she was nice to you. then you were outside waiting for your aunt, and she pulled up in a little round convertible. you crossed a little bridge over a creek, turned back, and she dropped you at the house again. it all just felt normal. after that you were sitting with a couple people, inside you think, playing with a string of blue balloons, and that's where it ends

did i get that right, or did i miss anything?
yeah that's it, you got it all. the only thing is "it all just felt normal" was really just the car ride, i don't remember how the rest felt. but otherwise yep that's the dream

got it, so it was just the drive with your aunt that felt normal. the rest of it, how it felt is a blank, and that's fine

that sound right now?
yep that sounds right 🙂

good, i've got your dream then

would you like to see it drawn?
yeah i'd love that!

yay, okay

i can see it going a few ways. like a gentle storybook painting, where nobody inside it thinks any of it is strange. or faded old family snapshots, some bits clear and some just gone. or a soft coloured pencil sketch, like someone drawing it from memory and only filling in what stuck. or just an ordinary photo, how it looked to you, real and normal but quietly impossible

which of those feels closest? or you can tell me your own idea
the storybook one i think. nobody in it acted like any of it was weird, it just was

storybook it is. i'll start with the young woman

i picture her with shoulder length blonde hair in that pageboy cut. the clothes are my guess, just something simple and everyday with an apron over it since she's cooking

anything different about her, or would you leave it to me?
yeah the hair's right. i don't remember what she was wearing so go with your guess, the apron sounds good

okay, i'm sketching her now, plus your aunt, the couple people, the back stairs, the short empty hallway, the tiny room, outside the house, the little bridge over the creek, the room with the balloons, the little round convertible and the string of blue balloons. it'll show up on the right. just those for now

next is the pied piper sort of guy. i picture a man with curly hair. my guesses are that he's a sort of pied piper man who lives in the village, in colourful old-fashioned clothes like a piper would wear

anything different about him, or would you leave it to me?
curly hair's right. i don't remember his clothes or if he lived there, so go with your guess. the colourful piper outfit sounds good

okay, sketching the pied piper sort of guy now, he'll show up on the right. just him for now

then the village inside the Meads's house. i picture it right inside the front door, a whole european village with a cobblestone street, the house way bigger inside than out. my guesses are you'd see the front door, the cobblestone street running off from it, and old european village houses along it

anything different about it, or would you leave it to me?
yeah that's right, it was just inside, a village with a cobblestone street. i don't really remember the houses or the door itself so go with your guess, that sounds good
okay, sketching the village now, right inside the front door with the cobblestone street and old houses along it. it'll show up on the right
ok cool, can't wait to see it 🙂

the village inside the Meads's house is being sketched now, it'll show up on the right. just that for now

do you want to tell me a little about how you look, so it's really you? or should i just imagine you?
i don't really remember how i looked in the dream, so just imagine me, that's fine 🙂

okay, i'll imagine you then. sketching you now

everything's being sketched and it'll show up on the right over the next minute or two. if anything looks off once it's there, just tell me
oh cool, they're all there! yeah that looks right to me 🙂

yay, i'm really glad

your aunt in that little round car, the blue balloons, the stove taking up the whole room. all there

if anything doesn't quite match how you remember it, even something small, just say
nope, it all looks right to me. the stove taking up the whole room made me laugh, that's exactly how it was 🙂 thanks berry

ha, that stove really was something

thanks for sharing it with me. a whole village tucked inside the Meads's house, a juggler, a nice lady and her enormous stove, a little drive over the creek, and blue balloons at the end. that's a lovely one to get to keep 🙂

geography.value: a whole small european village, bigger than it seems, laid out along one cobblestone street that runs straight ahead from a wooden front door and gently curves out of sight, with a little open square partway along

light.value: soft even daylight across the whole street, with gentle shadows

geography.value: a narrow indoor back staircase in an old house: one short flight of plain wooden steps rising to a small landing, with a second flight going straight back down on the far side, like a little hump

landmarks.value: worn ochre-brown wooden steps and a simple wooden handrail on each flight, beige plaster walls close on both sides, a small square landing at the top between the two flights

light.value: soft even daylight from an unseen window above the landing

geography.value: a short, narrow, empty indoor hallway in a house, a few steps long, running straight and then turning a right-angle corner at its far end; plain beige plaster walls, bare wooden floorboards, a flat white ceiling

landmarks.value: the right-angle corner at the far end, a plain wooden baseboard along both walls, a small open doorway just past the corner

light.value: soft, even indoor daylight with gentle pale shadows gathering into the corner

geography.value: a tiny square kitchen room, indoors, with plain beige plastered walls and a grey stone floor; a large iron stove fills almost the whole room, pushed against the back wall, leaving only a narrow strip of floor in front of it and a doorway in one side wall

landmarks.value: the huge dark grey cast-iron stove with several round burners on top, an oven door with a steel blue handle, and a short stovepipe rising into the ceiling

light.value: soft even daylight filling the room, with gentle shadows under the stove

geography.value: a quiet residential street; a modest two-storey family house set back behind a small front lawn, a short paved path from the front door to a narrow road running along the front, a creek with a little stone bridge further down the road

landmarks.value: the house with a front door and windows, a small front lawn and path, the narrow road in front, a little bridge over a creek down the road

landmarks.value: the little stone bridge with low stone side walls, the creek of clear shallow water with smooth pebbles running beneath the arch, a few leafy trees and reeds along the banks

geography.value: an indoor room, a cozy house living room, roughly square, with a sofa along one wall, a round coffee table in the middle and a plain window on the far wall

light.value: soft even warm daylight filling the room, gentle shadows

appearance.value: a little round two-seater convertible car, about the size of a small bubble car, with a short rounded bonnet, curved domed fenders, round headlamps, open top with the soft roof folded down at the back, four small wheels, painted soft steel blue
